dedupe_keys.name: traffic accident data in changchun northeast china

description: Traffic Accident Data in Changchun, Northeast China. is a data set deposited in Figshare by its authors Qiuyang Huang. It describes a traffic network in Changchun city of northeast China by using weighted edges-list and node-list. Each node represents a crossing in the road network with longitude and latitude, each edge represents a road section, the weight of each edge is deﬁned as total number of traffic accidents occurred on each road. Coverage: national (CN); the metadata date the deposit to 2019. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 0 Bytes. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-figshare-repository.
